newsitem.title: GREECE: Young Greek completes solo Atlantic voyage.
newsitem.headline: Young Greek completes solo Atlantic voyage.

text.p: A 23-year-old sociology student fulfilled a life-long dream by sailing alone across the Atlantic and the Mediterranean from the United States to his native Greece.
Christos Papaliolios arrived in the port of Patras on the Peloponnese coast on Monday after sailing 6,000 nautical miles (10,800 kms) in three months.
"My driving force was my father," said Papaliolios, whose father is a ship's captain.
"Throughout my life he has told me that exploration in life is the most important thing, and the unexplored is not worth living, as Socrates said," he told Reuters television in Patras.
He arrived on the 25-foot (eight metre) sailboat Teresa, a 35-year-old craft he bought for $3,500 after working as a waiter in a Manhattan restaurant in New York.
His parents and Patras residents cheered as he arrived and held a banner aloft proclaiming: "Christos, for those who dare, watch out."
